name: A50S Smart Projector
description:
A compact projector that runs Android and connects to Wi-Fi, so it plays films and shows without a laptop. It throws a 50 to 200 inch picture at native 1080p (it accepts 4K video), with 360 ANSI lumens and a 2500:1 contrast ratio, so it looks best in a dim or dark room.

Auto keystone squares the picture up when the projector sits at an angle, and the stand turns all the way round, so it can point at a wall or the ceiling.

Dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz) and Bluetooth 5.0. About 17.6 × 18.3 × 7.4 cm. Comes with a UK 3-pin plug.

source.notes: Order the UK plug. ¥375 with the first-order coupon. Supplier photos cleaned locally; the app-logo row (YouTube, Netflix, Google Play) and the spec collage left out. The listing also claims '7200 lumens', which contradicts its own 360 ANSI figure: not used. No streaming apps are promised by name.
